description: A `select` carrying a meaningless `schema` stays VALID. The v0.6 answerability constraints are scoped to the mode=input conditional, not hung on the `schema` property: `schema` does nothing on an option-based ask, and an otherwise answerable v0.4/v0.5 select that happens to carry one must not be newly rejected. Pins the scoping so the constraint cannot drift back onto the property.
